card.name: Long time spans: months or years
card.fires_on: Plural time units like years, months, weeks (or year after 'a') that stretch a duration upward, often after 'possibly', 'or even', 'lasting', or 'weeks or'.

modes.label: Escalating duration
modes.description: A longer time unit follows 'or even' or 'possibly' to extend an estimated span.
modes.example: Maximum improvement may not be seen for weeks or even<< months>>.

modes.label: Lasting or taking a duration
modes.description: A time unit follows 'lasting' or 'take' to say how long an effect or condition persists.
modes.example: it may take<< weeks>> for plasma levels to decrease.

modes.label: Large quantity escalation
modes.description: A bigger number word follows 'or even' in a non-time count.
modes.example: each frame can be hundreds of millions, or even<< billions>> of pixels.

card.plain: It lights up on words like years or months when text says something may last longer than expected.
